Title: Sabbat Priest - how much of blood?

Messages.Author: Cypis
Messages.Body:
Hello.
My name is Cypis, and I was just introduced to VTES....well, I know about the game for many many years now, and it was latest local tournament that pushed me

Anyway:

is there any general rule about resolution of multiples of the same effect?

To be precise:

Sabbat Priest
Cardtype: Political Action
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Choose a ready Sabbat vampire. Successful referendum means that for the remainder of the game, any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood.

This is most recent card text.
As far as I understand, it is possible to got the same vampire to become sabbat priest several times, adding virtual "any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood" many times to their card - am I right ?

If so - does blocking vampire burns 1 blood (satisfying the logical / semiotic requirement), OR does it make them burn 1 blood for each virtual "any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood" ?

If the latter - where is it stated in general rules?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:

>

> As far as I understand, it is possible to got the same vampire to become sabbat priest several times, adding virtual "any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood" many times to their card - am I right ?
>
Correct.

> Cypis wrote:
> If so - does blocking vampire burns 1 blood (satisfying the logical / semiotic requirement), OR does it make them burn 1 blood for each virtual "any vampire attempting to block the chosen vampire burns 1 blood" ?
>
One per copy.

> Cypis wrote:
> If the latter - where is it stated in general rules?
>
By default, you can apply the cardtext of each card individually.
